situation: I sell handmade ceramic mugs on Etsy. A customer just DM'd me a photo of a mug that arrived cracked. I can ship a replacement tomorrow or refund her.
reply: Oh no, I'm so sorry, that's not how it should have arrived. Could you send one more photo of the box? Then I'll ship a replacement tomorrow, no need to send the broken one back. If you'd rather have a refund, just say and it's done.
note: Never make them return a broken item first; the photo is enough.

situation: I'm Marco; we print packaging for a cosmetics brand. Their 5,000 boxes (PO 8812) will arrive 6 November instead of 27 October because our foil supplier is behind, but I could send 2,000 unfoiled boxes on 27 October free. Contact is Lena, their launch is Nov 20.
reply: Hi Lena, PO 8812 (5,000 printed boxes) will now reach you on 6 November instead of 27 October, because our foil supplier is behind. That still leaves two weeks before your launch on the 20th. If that's too tight for your filling schedule, I can send 2,000 unfoiled boxes on 27 October at no charge so your line can start, with the full foiled order on the 6th. Let me know by Friday which you'd prefer; if I don't hear back, the full order arrives on the 6th, and I'll confirm the dates in writing either way. Marco
note: B2B customers need a plan they can pass on, so lead with the date and the launch buffer.

situation: Ich bin Jana und habe einen kleinen Online-Teeshop. Frau Krüger hat Winterapfel bestellt (Bestellung 3087), der schon ausverkauft war, als der Shop die Bestellung annahm; neue Lieferung am 20. Oktober. Bratapfel ist vorrätig und ginge morgen raus, ich kann ihr eine Probe unserer neuen Rooibos-Mischung schenken oder sofort erstatten.
reply: Hallo Frau Krüger, der Winterapfel aus Ihrer Bestellung 3087 ist ausverkauft, das hätte unser Shop gar nicht mehr annehmen dürfen. Die neue Lieferung kommt am 20. Oktober, und Ihr Paket geht am selben Tag raus. Drei Möglichkeiten: Sie warten, und ich lege eine Probe unserer neuen Rooibos-Mischung dazu; Sie nehmen stattdessen den Bratapfel, der morgen verschickt wird; oder Sie bekommen heute die volle Erstattung. Wenn ich bis Freitag nichts höre, halte ich die Bestellung für den 20. fest. Entschuldigen Sie die Umstände. Viele Grüße, Jana
note: Die Standardoption nennen, damit auch Nichtstun eine klare Wahl ist.

situation: 我是淘宝手工香薰蜡烛店的店主小周。顾客林女士的订单（尾号5816）物流9月22号之后就没更新，今天快递确认在中转站丢件。她是买来送朋友10月3号生日的，还没来问。今天下午重发特快，10月2日能到；她要退款也可以。
reply: 林女士您好，您的订单（尾号5816）出了问题：快递今天确认包裹在中转站丢失了，我们刚查到，先跟您说一声。我今天下午给您重新发一份，走特快，10月2日送到，赶得上您朋友3号的生日。如果您更想退款，回我“退款”两个字，我当天原路退回。今晚之前没收到回复的话，我就按重发处理，单号发您；原来那份如果后来到了，您留着就好。给您添麻烦了。店主小周
note: 主动先说，不等顾客来问：补发围绕她送礼的日期安排，退款只需回两个字，默认做法写清楚。

situation: I'm Tom and I make custom oak dining tables. Customer Marcus was promised Oct 2 after I already pushed it once from Sept 18. Now the tabletop finish didn't cure evenly and needs redoing, so it'll be Oct 16, a date I'm sure of. He's hosting family on the 17th; I'll refund his $150 delivery fee. If he'd rather not wait, I'll refund the whole order.
reply: Hi Marcus, your table won't make 2 October, and I know this is the second time I've moved it. The finish on the top didn't cure evenly and I'm redoing it. It will be delivered on Friday 16 October, a date I'm certain of, the day before your family arrives. I've refunded the $150 delivery fee today. If you'd rather not wait, I'll refund the whole order instead; if I don't hear back, the 16th stands. I'll send you photos of the finished top on Monday 12 October. Tom
note: On a second slip, refund something unasked and give only a date you are sure you can keep.

situation: I'm Maya at Lanternfly Games. 312 people preordered our card game Night Market ($34) for early October; the print run failed quality check (muddy colours), so shipping moves to around Nov 13, firm date by Oct 30. Harbour Lights is in stock and ships this week, refunds go through within two days, and I'll add the promo expansion free. Need to email everyone.
reply:
Subject: Your Night Market preorder now ships around November 13
Hi everyone,
Your Night Market preorder is delayed: it will ship around November 13 instead of early October. The first print run failed our quality check (the colours came out muddy), and I'd rather reprint than send a game I'm not proud of. You can wait and get tracking the day it ships, swap to Harbour Lights, which is in stock and ships this week, or reply 'refund' for your full $34 within two days. If I don't hear from you, your order stays as it is. Every order will include the promo expansion as a thank-you. I'll email again on October 30 with a firm date.
Maya, Lanternfly Games
note: A mass email to many buyers: the delay in the subject line, one line of reason, three options and a default, so nobody has to reply.

situation: I'm Jo and I sell linen clothing online. Customer Dana emailed asking where her dress (#6203, $128) is; it should have shipped last week, but the fabric is late and it now ships Monday Oct 5. I hadn't told her yet. The sage colour is in stock and could go out today, or I can refund her in full.
reply:
Hi Dana, you're right to ask and I'm sorry you had to: order #6203, your linen dress, is delayed, and I should have told you before you needed to ask. The fabric reached us late, and your dress now ships on Monday 5 October. Three options: wait, and I'll send tracking the day it ships; swap for the sage colour, which is in stock and goes out today; or a full refund of $128 today. If I don't hear back, I'll ship it on the 5th.
Jo
note: Reactive, after 'where is my order?': thank them for asking, own not telling them first, then the date, three options and the default.

situation: I'm Leah and I sell leather wallets on my own website. Customer Ben emailed: tracking says order #2194 was delivered Friday but he never got it. Nothing on the doorstep, neighbours haven't seen it. It was $85. I've opened a courier claim this morning asking for the GPS drop point; if it hasn't turned up by Thursday 1 October I'll send an express replacement and he keeps both if the first appears, or I can refund now.
reply:
Hi Ben, I'm sorry, that's frustrating after watching the tracking. Tracking shows order #2194 delivered on Friday 25 September, so I've opened a claim with the courier this morning and asked for the GPS drop point. Could you check once with your building manager or mailroom? If it hasn't turned up by Thursday 1 October, I'll send a replacement by express that day, and if the first one appears you keep both. Or say 'refund' and I'll refund the $85 today. I'll email you Thursday either way.
Leah
note: 'Delivered but not received' is still yours to fix: one reasonable check for him, a claim for you, a firm date for the replacement and refund as an easy exit.

situation: 我是开网店卖儿童绘本的阿宁。顾客张先生订了三本（订单尾号3392），其中《小熊的秋天》出版社缺货，是我们没及时下架，10月20日才到货，另外两本是现货。这本也可以单独退款，分开补寄的运费我们出。他还不知道。
reply: 张先生您好，您的订单（尾号3392）里有一本出了问题：《小熊的秋天》出版社缺货，10月20日到货，是我们没及时下架。另外两本现货，明天就能发。三种方式您选：1是先发两本，《小熊的秋天》20日到货当天单独补寄，运费我们出；2是三本等到20日一起发；3是这本直接退款，今天原路退回。您不回复的话，我就按第1种先发两本。有问题随时找我。店主阿宁
note: 部分缺货：先说哪本、哪天到，再给三个选择和默认选项；分开寄的运费由店家承担。

situation: I'm Maya and I sell knitwear online. Customer Hannah ordered a navy wool scarf (#5532) as a birthday gift for Saturday, and I sent the grey one by mistake. She emailed me a photo this morning; express today gets the navy one to her by Thursday. She can keep the grey one, or I'll refund in full if she prefers.
reply:
Hi Hannah, you're right, order #5532 should have been the navy scarf and I sent grey, that's my mistake. The navy one goes out today by express and will be with you by Thursday 1 October, in time for Saturday. Keep the grey one, no need to send it back. If you'd rather have a full refund instead, just say and I'll process it today. I'll email you tracking by 5pm.
Maya
note: Your mistake: own it in one line, fix it before the deadline that matters to them, and let the make-good (keep the wrong one) do the apologising.

situation: I'm Laura and I sell handmade leather bags from the UK. Customer Chris in Toronto, order #3308, is stuck in Canadian customs, and they want him to pay $38 CAD in duties that my checkout never mentioned. He hasn't messaged me yet. I'll refund the $38 if he sends the receipt, or cancel and refund the whole order.
reply:
Hi Chris,
Your order #3308 has reached Canada but is being held at customs, and they're asking for $38 CAD in import duties before releasing it. That's on me: the checkout should have warned you and it didn't. If you pay through the courier's link in their email and send me the receipt, I'll refund the $38 the same day. If you'd rather not, reply 'cancel' and I'll refund the whole order today. I'll check the tracking on Thursday and email you then either way.
Laura
note: Proactive, owns the missing warning, and the make-good covers the surprise fee; refund stays the easiest option to pick.

situation: I'm Nina and I make engraved name necklaces on my own. I sprained my wrist and can't engrave until Monday Oct 12 (express would arrive Oct 14). Customer Olivia ordered #1187 ($68) for her mum's birthday on Friday Oct 9; I promised dispatch Oct 1. An unengraved birthstone pendant could ship tomorrow. I can email her a printable card with a photo of the necklace today, or refund in full.
reply:
Hi Olivia, your order #1187 (the engraved name necklace) won't reach you before your mum's birthday on Friday 9 October, and I'm sorry. I've sprained my wrist and can't engrave until Monday 12 October; it would ship that day by express and arrive by Wednesday the 14th. Three options: wait, and I'll email you a printable card with a photo of her necklace today so you have something to give her on the 9th; swap for the unengraved birthstone pendant, which ships tomorrow and arrives in time; or a full refund of the $68 today. If I don't hear back by Thursday, I'll keep your order for the 12th. I'll email you tracking the day it ships.
Nina
note: When the deadline can't be met, say so first, give the personal reason in one plain line, and build the options around her real date.

situation: Sou o Rui e tenho uma loja de material de pintura no Porto que também vende online. A encomenda 2290 da Sofia (tintas a óleo, 64 €) está parada no centro da transportadora por causa de uma greve, que só retoma as entregas na segunda-feira, 12 de outubro; ela ainda não perguntou. Ela pode levantar as mesmas tintas na loja amanhã a partir das 10h e eu mando recolher a encomenda parada, ou reembolso-a já.
reply:
Olá Sofia, a sua encomenda 2290 (as tintas a óleo) está parada no centro de distribuição da transportadora por causa de uma greve, e as entregas só são retomadas na segunda-feira, 12 de outubro. Tem três opções: espera, e envio-lhe o seguimento assim que a encomenda voltar a andar; levanta as mesmas tintas na nossa loja do Porto amanhã a partir das 10h, e eu trato de recolher a encomenda parada; ou reembolso-lhe os 64 € hoje. Se não tiver notícias suas até sexta, a encomenda segue com a entrega a partir de dia 12. Peço desculpa pelo atraso.
Rui
note: Quando o atraso é da transportadora e a loja fica perto, o levantamento na loja é a troca mais rápida: a causa numa linha e logo as opções.

situation: 我是卖茶具的网店店主小林。顾客吴女士订的一套青瓷茶具（订单尾号7721），收货地址填成了她以前住的小区，快递员电话也没打通，包裹正在退回，预计10月6号回到我这。重寄运费我们出，也可以全额退款。她还不知道。
reply: 吴女士您好，您的订单（尾号7721）遇到点问题：收货地址是您以前住的小区，快递员联系不上您，包裹正在退回我这边，预计10月6日到。您把现在的地址发我，包裹一回来我当天重新寄出，这次运费我们出。如果不想再等，回我“退款”，我今天就全额原路退回。收到您的新地址之前，包裹我先留在店里，不会再寄。店主小林
note: 就算是顾客填错了地址，也不追究是谁的错：说清事实、新日期和选项，默认做法写明白，补一次运费是小小的善意。

situation: 我是做手工皮具的阿杰。陈先生订了刻字钱包（尾号2046），寄到杭州他父亲家，作为10月5日的生日惊喜。酒红色皮料延迟，最早10月9日发，加急10月11日前到，加急运费我出；深棕色有现货，明天发10月3日前到。也可以全额退款。只能联系陈先生，不能让老人知道。
reply: 陈先生您好，您给父亲订的刻字钱包（订单尾号2046）赶不上10月5日的生日了，先跟您说一声。原因是酒红色皮料延迟到货，最早10月9日刻好发出，走加急10月11日前送到。三种选择：一是等到10月9日发货，运费升级为加急，我来出；二是换成现货的深棕色款，刻同样的字，明天发出，10月3日前送到；三是全额退款，今天原路退回。周五（10月2日）前没收到您的回复，我就按第一种处理。所有消息我只发给您，不会联系您父亲。给您添麻烦了。店主阿杰
note: 礼物直接寄给收件人时，只和下单人沟通，并说明不会惊动收礼的人；选项围绕他真正在意的生日来设计。

situation: 山田農園の山田です。新米のネット販売で、佐藤様から新米コシヒカリ5kg（注文番号1042）を10月5日発送でご注文いただいていますが、長雨で稲刈りが遅れ、発送は10月16日になります。昨年産のコシヒカリなら在庫があり、5kgで600円安いです。全額返金にも対応できます。
reply:
佐藤様
ご注文の新米コシヒカリ5kg（注文番号1042）について、長雨で稲刈りが遅れ、10月5日のお約束だった発送が10月16日（金）になります。お待ちいただける場合は、16日に発送し、当日に追跡番号をお知らせします。すぐにお米が必要でしたら、在庫のある昨年産コシヒカリ5kgを明日発送し、差額の600円をお返しします。全額返金をご希望でしたら、本日中に手続きいたします。10月2日（金）までにご返信がなければ、16日の発送でお待ちいただく形で進めます。お待たせして申し訳ありません。
山田農園　山田
note: 天候による遅れでも、新しい日付、三つの選択肢、返信がない場合の扱いを一度に伝える。

situation: I run a small online yarn shop. Grace ordered 8 skeins of the Moss colourway (order #7710, $22 each, $176 total) for a sweater, but I only have 5, and the dyer has just told me Moss is discontinued. Fern is a similar green and I have 12 skeins in stock at the same price; I'll hold her order until Monday Oct 5, then refund in full if I haven't heard. I'm Mia.
reply: Hi Grace, I can't fill your order #7710 for 8 skeins of Moss: I have 5 left, and the dyer has just told me Moss is discontinued, so no more are coming. Your options: swap all 8 for Fern, a similar green I have in stock at the same price; take the 5 Moss and a $66 refund for the other 3; or a full refund of $176. I'll hold your order until Monday 5 October, and if I haven't heard from you by then I'll refund it in full. Just reply with the one you'd like. Mia
note: When the item is never coming back, drop the wait option and make the full refund the default.

situation: I make wooden baby teething rings. In my final check I found hairline cracks in several rings from the current batch, so I'm holding the whole batch; the new one is ready Wednesday Oct 21. Customer Aisha's order #3319 ($24) hasn't shipped. The maple rattle is from a different batch, passed its check and could ship tomorrow, and I'm happy to add free express or refund her in full. I'm Theo.
reply: Hi Aisha, your order #3319, the teething ring, won't ship this week. In my final check I found hairline cracks in several rings from this batch, and I won't send anything meant for a baby's mouth unless I'm sure of it, so I'm holding the whole batch. The new batch is ready on Wednesday 21 October and yours ships that day. Three options: wait, and I'll add free express shipping; swap for the maple rattle, which is from a different batch, passed its check and ships tomorrow; or a full refund of $24 today. If I don't hear back by Monday 5 October, I'll hold your order for the 21st. Theo
note: A quality hold on a baby product is a reason to state plainly in one line, never a date to rush. If any rings from this batch have already gone out, contact those buyers today and ask them to stop using them.

situation: 我是小周，在小区微信群做水果团购，42户订了阳光玫瑰葡萄，原定10月2日周五到货。果园刚通知连续下雨推迟采摘，改到10月6日周二到。现在有巨峰葡萄现货，价格一样，明天就能取；要退款的我当天原路退。
reply: 各位邻居好，我是团购的小周。大家订的阳光玫瑰葡萄要晚几天：原定10月2日（周五）到货，果园那边连续下雨，采摘推迟，改为10月6日（周二）到，到货当天我在群里通知取货。不想等的有两个选择：换成现货的巨峰葡萄，价格一样，明天就能取；或者私信我“退款”，当天原路退回。今晚12点前没私信我的，就默认等6号的阳光玫瑰。给大家添麻烦了，谢谢理解。
note: 微信群团购：一条消息通知所有人，选项私信处理，免得群里变成投诉现场。

situation: I'm Elif and I sell vintage lamps on my own site and on a marketplace. Last night the green 1960s glass lamp sold on both within an hour; the marketplace buyer paid first, so Hugo's order #5120 ($145) on my site can't be filled. I have a similar amber lamp from the same era at $135, and a green one listed at $160 that I'm happy to let him have for $145, or I can refund him in full.
reply:
Hi Hugo, I can't send the green 1960s glass lamp from your order #5120: it sold on another site shortly before you ordered, and as it's one of a kind there isn't another coming. That's my mistake, my listings didn't sync in time. Your options: a full refund of $145, processed today; the amber lamp from the same era at $135, with the $10 difference refunded; or the green lamp listed at $160, for the same $145. Photos of both are attached. If I don't hear from you by Friday 2 October, I'll refund you in full.
Elif
note: A one-of-a-kind item has no wait option: refund is the default, and the alternatives come with photos.

situation: 我是卖手工羊毛围巾的小苏。赵女士订的灰色围巾（尾号4410，198元）原定10月15日前发货，但织工阿姨病了，什么时候回来还不确定，10月5日（周一）我才知道新日期。米色款有现货，明天能发，也可以全额退款。
reply: 赵女士您好，您订的灰色羊毛围巾（订单尾号4410）可能赶不上10月15日前发货：负责织围巾的阿姨生病了，什么时候能回来还说不准。10月5日（周一）我会知道确切的发货日期，当天就告诉您。三种选择：一是等5号的新日期；二是换成现货的米色款，明天发出；三是回我“退款”，198元当天原路全额退回。没收到您回复的话，我先保留订单，5号再跟您确认。给您添麻烦了。小苏
note: 还给不出新日期时，就给出“哪天能知道”的日期，同样附上三个选择和默认做法。

situation: I'm Priya and I run a small coffee subscription: 140 subscribers were charged $24 on Oct 1 for the October box, due to ship Monday Oct 5. Our roaster's machine broke down, so the boxes will now ship Monday Oct 12. Anyone who'd rather skip October gets a full refund, and I need to email everyone today.
reply:
Subject: Your October box now ships Monday 12 October
Hi there, your October coffee box will ship on Monday 12 October instead of Monday 5 October, because our roaster's machine broke down this week. If you're happy to wait, you don't need to do anything: it ships on the 12th and I'll send tracking the same day. If you'd rather skip October, just reply 'skip' and I'll refund your $24 in full that day. I'll be in touch again on the 12th when the boxes go out.
Priya
note: Subscribers have already paid, so the refund has to be a one-word reply, and doing nothing means waiting.

situation: 我开家具店。顾客陈先生的三人沙发（订单尾号6630）原定10月9日（周五）上午送货安装，他说那天特意请了假。我们的送装车队排期出了错，最早只能10月10日（周六）上午，或者10月12日（周一）以后他挑一天。是我们的问题，想免掉他200元送装费，他不想等也可以全额退款。我是客服小吴。
reply: 陈先生您好，您的三人沙发（订单尾号6630）原定10月9日（周五）上午送装，我们这边排不上了，是我们车队排期出了错，先跟您说一声。我知道您那天特意请了假，真的很抱歉。现在可以改到10月10日（周六）上午，或者10月12日（周一）以后您挑任意一天；如果不想再等，也可以全额退款，当天原路退回。这次的200元送装费我们免掉。10月7日前没收到您回复的话，我就先给您留着10日上午。客服小吴
note: 上门送装的延误，代价是客户为此请的假：先认这一点，再给新日期、退款和默认安排。

situation: I'm Ruth and I run a small plant nursery. Mr Patel ordered three bare-root apple trees (order 0412, £135) for delivery on Saturday 3 October, but our grower has pushed them to Saturday 17 October. He doesn't use email, so I'm leaving a voicemail; I can deliver three potted apple trees this Saturday at no extra cost instead or refund him in full, and my number is 07700 900472.
reply: Hello Mr Patel, it's Ruth from the nursery, about your order 0412, the three apple trees. They won't make Saturday 3 October: our grower has moved the bare-root trees to Saturday 17 October, and we'd deliver yours that day. If you'd rather not wait, I can bring three potted apple trees this Saturday at no extra cost, or refund your £135 in full. If I don't hear from you, I'll keep your order for the 17th. My number is 07700 900472, again, 07700 900472. I'll ring you on Monday either way.
note: On a voicemail, lead with who you are and which order, keep the options short, and say the number twice.

situation: 我是做海鲜批发的老周。望江楼的王师傅订了30公斤冰鲜三文鱼（单号A0927），10月3日（周六）早上送到，做婚宴用。进口航班取消，周六只能到18公斤，剩下12公斤要10月5日（周一）才到。三文鱼一公斤150元，我有现货冰鲜鲈鱼可以补，一公斤60元。
reply: 王师傅，您单号A0927的30公斤三文鱼出了问题，先跟您说一声：进口航班取消了，周六（10月3日）早上只能送到18公斤，剩下12公斤要10月5日（周一）才到，赶不上婚宴。周六早上的18公斤照常送。差的12公斤您看：一是换成现货冰鲜鲈鱼12公斤，周六一起送到，720元，差价1080元退给您；二是这12公斤不要了，1800元当天退给您。麻烦您明天（10月2日）中午12点前定一下，到时候没收到消息，我先把鲈鱼备好，再打电话跟您确认，您同意了才送。老周
note: B2B客户最关心的是自己的出菜计划：先给能确定到的量，再给救急的替代、退款和明确的决定时间。

situation: I'm Owen and I make handmade chocolates. A gift box (order #2871) bought by a customer called Laura for her friend Ruth arrived melted after sitting in a hot depot over the weekend, and Ruth, not Laura, has just emailed me a photo. I can send a new box in an insulated pack tomorrow to arrive Monday 5 October, and I'll let Laura know it's sorted without making Ruth deal with a refund.
reply: Hi Ruth, thank you for letting me know, and I'm sorry, that's not how Laura's gift should have reached you. The box sat in a hot depot over the weekend and the chocolates didn't survive it. I'll send a fresh box tomorrow in an insulated pack, arriving Monday 5 October, and there's no need to send the melted one back; please don't eat any that melted, just to be safe. I'll let Laura know it's been sorted so she doesn't hear about it any other way. Owen
note: When the recipient reports the problem, fix it with them directly and keep money questions for the buyer.

situation: I'm Sam and I make ceramic table lamps. Yesterday I emailed Derek that his order #4418 ($210) will ship Wednesday 14 October instead of this week because a glaze firing failed, with the options to wait, swap or get a refund, and said I'd hold it for the 14th if I didn't hear back. He replied angrily: 'This is ridiculous, I'll just file a chargeback with my bank.'
reply:
Understood, Derek, and I'm sorry this has been frustrating. Your lamp, order #4418, ships on Wednesday 14 October, and you'll have tracking the same day. If you'd rather not wait, reply 'refund' and I'll refund the full $210 today. If I don't hear otherwise, it ships on the 14th as planned.
Sam
note: An angry reply gets no re-explaining of the glaze: confirm the date, offer the refund again, and leave the chargeback as his call.

situation: I'm Jade and I sell candles through my Instagram shop. Under my latest post, a customer, Mel, commented publicly: 'Ordered 2 weeks ago and still nothing, is this shop even real?' Her order #3391 left us on 21 September but tracking stopped on 24 September at a sorting hub; I can open a trace today, send a replacement by express if it hasn't moved by Monday 5 October, or refund her in full if she prefers, and I don't want her order details in a public comment.
reply: Hi Mel, you're right to ask, and I'm sorry it's taken this long. Your parcel left us and then stalled at a sorting hub, so I'm opening a trace with the courier today. If it hasn't moved by Monday 5 October, I'll send you a replacement by express, or a full refund if you'd rather. I've sent you a DM with the details. Jade
note: In public, own it and show the plan with a date so other followers see it handled; the order number and options go in the DM.

situation: Soy Carmen y tengo una tienda online de muebles de pino, Pino Claro. A la clienta Beatriz le llegó ayer el armario del pedido 5531 sin la bolsa de herrajes (bisagras y tornillos), y me lo acaba de decir por WhatsApp; ya lo tenía medio montado. Puedo enviarle la bolsa hoy por mensajería urgente para que llegue el viernes 2 de octubre, devolverle 20 euros por las molestias, o recoger el armario sin coste y reembolsarle el pedido entero.
reply:
Hola, Beatriz. Tienes razón, al armario del pedido 5531 le faltaba la bolsa de herrajes, y el fallo es nuestro al empaquetar. Te la envío hoy por mensajería urgente y llegará el viernes 2 de octubre; esta tarde te paso el número de seguimiento. Por las molestias te devuelvo hoy mismo 20 euros. Si prefieres devolver el armario, lo recogemos sin coste y te reembolso el pedido entero. Si no me dices nada, sigo con el envío de la bolsa.
Carmen, Pino Claro
note: Pieza que falta: no le pidas pruebas ni que desmonte nada; envía la pieza ya, ofrece la salida fácil y deja claro qué pasa si no contesta.

situation: I'm Hugo and I run a small online pet supply shop. Ms Okafor has a monthly repeat order (#8840) for a 2kg bag of prescription renal diet cat food, $46, due to ship tomorrow, but the manufacturer has a production delay and my next delivery is Monday 19 October. I have three 400g bags of the same food in stock at $10 each, which I can ship tomorrow with free shipping, and I don't stock any equivalent food.
reply:
Hi Ms Okafor, your repeat order #8840, the 2kg bag of renal diet cat food, won't ship tomorrow: the manufacturer has a production delay, and my next delivery is Monday 19 October. Three options: I send three 400g bags of the same food tomorrow, $30 with free shipping, to tide you over; you wait for the 2kg bag on the 19th; or I refund the $46 today. If I don't hear back, I'll hold your order for the 19th and charge nothing extra. I don't stock an equivalent food, so please check any change of diet with your vet first.
Hugo
note: With food a pet depends on, offer a bridge from the same product and never suggest a substitute diet; that's the vet's call.

situation: I'm Kofi and I sell hand-printed T-shirts online. I swapped the labels on two parcels, so Ana (order #6120, two kids' T-shirts) received another customer's order, with that customer's name and address on the packing slip, and she's just emailed me a photo. I can send Ana's order today by express to arrive Tuesday 6 October, refund her $10 for the trouble, arrange a free courier pickup of the other parcel on Monday 5 October, or refund her in full if she prefers.
reply:
Hi Ana, thank you for telling me, and I'm sorry: I swapped the labels on two parcels, so you received another customer's order instead of your order #6120. Your two kids' T-shirts go out today by express and will arrive on Tuesday 6 October, and I've refunded $10 for the trouble. Could you keep the other parcel aside, unworn, and not share the packing slip, as it has the other customer's details on it? A courier will collect it from you on Monday 5 October at no cost; if you'd rather have a full refund instead of the reship, just say so.
Kofi
note: A mix-up exposes someone else's details: fix her order first, then ask once, plainly, for the other parcel and slip to stay private.

situation: 我是做定制运动服的阿峰。少儿足球队的刘指导订了15件队服（订单尾号5208），已经送到，但我今天发现其中一件把“李浩然”印成了“李浩燃”，是我们排版出的错，他还没发现。比赛是10月10日（周六）；我可以今天重印，加急10月8日（周四）送到，运费我出，印错的不用寄回；或者这一件退款68元。
reply: 刘指导您好，订单尾号5208的15件队服里，有一件把“李浩然”印成了“李浩燃”，是我们排版出的错，先跟您说一声。我今天重印这一件，走加急，10月8日（周四）送到，赶得上周六的比赛，运费我们出，印错的那件不用寄回。如果您更想退这一件的钱，回我“退款”，68元当天原路退回。明天中午前没收到您的回复，我就按重印处理，发出后把单号发给您。阿峰
note: 团队订单只错了一件：主动先说，指明哪件错在哪，补救排在比赛日前，默认做法写清楚。

situation: I'm Grace and I run a small florist, Fernhill Flowers. Mr Byrne ordered a white lily wreath (order #2210, £85) for his aunt's funeral at St Anne's Church at 10am tomorrow, Saturday, but our lilies didn't arrive from the supplier this morning. I can make the same design in white roses and chrysanthemums and still deliver to the church by 9am, or refund him in full; if I don't hear by 6pm I'll go ahead with the roses, and I want to text him now and call at 4pm.
reply: Hello Mr Byrne, it's Grace at Fernhill Flowers, about order #2210, the wreath for your aunt's funeral tomorrow. Our white lilies didn't arrive from the supplier this morning, so I can't make it with lilies. I can make the same design in white roses and chrysanthemums and still have it at St Anne's Church by 9am, before the 10am service, or refund the £85 in full today. If I haven't heard from you by 6pm, I'll go ahead with the roses so it's there in time. I'll call you at 4pm, and I'm very sorry for your loss.
note: When the date can't move, drop the wait option and make the default the one that still arrives on time.

situation: I'm Theo at Larkspur Books, a small bookshop. Mrs Adeyemi prepaid $32 for a special order (#1458), the hardcover of a cookbook, and our distributor has just told us it's out of stock until a reprint that reaches us on Friday 20 November, at a new price of $38. I'll honour her $32; the paperback edition is in stock at $18 and I can refund the $14 difference, or refund her in full.
reply: Hi Mrs Adeyemi, your special order #1458, the cookbook hardcover, is out of stock: our distributor has just told us the reprint reaches us on Friday 20 November. The reprint price has gone up to $38, but you've paid $32 and that's what it stays. Three options: wait, and I'll let you know the day it arrives; take the paperback edition, which is in stock, and I'll refund the $14 difference today; or a full refund of $32 today. If I don't hear back by next Friday, I'll keep your order for the 20th. Theo, Larkspur Books
note: When the restock costs more, honour the price you took; the customer shouldn't pay for the wait twice.

situation: Je m'appelle Léa et je vends des bougies artisanales en ligne (atelier Mèche Claire). La commande 4417 de M. Dubois (52 €) a été perdue par le transporteur, je lui ai renvoyé un colis de remplacement le 18 septembre, et ce matin le transporteur m'a confirmé que celui-ci est perdu aussi. Je peux lui rembourser les 52 € aujourd'hui, ou lui renvoyer la commande lundi en envoi suivi avec signature, livrée le mardi 6 octobre, avec un coffret de 3 bougies offert.
reply:
Bonjour M. Dubois, le colis de remplacement de votre commande 4417 est perdu lui aussi : le transporteur me l'a confirmé ce matin. Après deux pertes, je ne veux pas vous faire attendre une troisième fois sans votre accord. Deux options : je vous rembourse les 52 € aujourd'hui, ou je vous renvoie la commande lundi en envoi suivi avec signature, livrée le mardi 6 octobre, avec un coffret de 3 bougies offert. Sans réponse de votre part d'ici lundi, je vous rembourse. Toutes mes excuses pour ce double contretemps.
Léa, atelier Mèche Claire
note: Après une deuxième perte, le remboursement devient l'option par défaut : on ne refait pas attendre le client sans son oui.

situation: 我是网店卖帆布鞋的小陈。何女士把买的38码小白鞋（订单尾号8135，259元）寄回来换39码，退回的鞋已经收到了，但白色39码刚好卖完，厂家下一批10月14日（周三）到货。米色39码有现货，明天能发；也可以全额退款259元。她还不知道。
reply: 何女士您好，您换货的订单（尾号8135）出了点问题：退回的38码我们已经收到，但白色39码刚好卖完了，厂家下一批10月14日（周三）到货，到货当天给您发出。三种选择：一是等14日的白色39码，发出后把单号发您；二是换成米色39码，有现货，明天就发；三是回我“退款”，259元当天原路全额退回。没收到您回复的话，我就先给您留着14日的白色39码。给您添麻烦了。小陈
note: 换货时缺码：先说退回的鞋已收到让她放心，再给日期、三个选择和默认做法。

situation: I'm Ivy and I sell handmade ceramic planters online. Rosa ordered the medium sage planter (#4672, $58); the restock came out of the kiln this week, but the new glaze batch is noticeably bluer than the photo she ordered from. I'll email her a photo of the actual planter and can ship it tomorrow if she's happy, swap it for the medium cream planter in stock, or refund her in full; I'll hold it until Wednesday 7 October and refund her if I haven't heard.
reply: Hi Rosa, your order #4672, the medium sage planter, is ready, but the new glaze batch came out noticeably bluer than the photo you ordered from, so I don't want to send it without checking with you first. I've attached a photo of your actual planter. Three options: if you like it, I'll ship it tomorrow; I can swap it for the medium cream planter, which is in stock; or I'll refund you in full. I'll hold it until Wednesday 7 October, and if I haven't heard by then I'll refund you in full. Ivy
note: When the item has changed from what they saw, never ship it by default: their yes comes first, and silence means a refund.

situation: I'm Noor and I sell handmade perfume online. Siobhan in Ireland ordered the jasmine perfume oil (order #3075, $34), and this week our courier told me they no longer carry perfume oils on international routes; I have no other way to ship it. The jasmine solid perfume, same scent, is $28, the courier does carry it, and it could ship tomorrow with the $6 difference refunded. If I haven't heard by Wednesday 7 October I'll refund her in full.
reply:
Hi Siobhan, I can't send your order #3075, the jasmine perfume oil, to Ireland: our courier told me this week they no longer carry perfume oils on international routes, and I have no other way to ship it. Two options: swap it for the jasmine solid perfume, the same scent, which the courier does carry; it ships tomorrow and I'll refund the $6 difference. Or a full refund of $34. If I haven't heard from you by Wednesday 7 October, I'll refund you in full.
Noor
note: When the item can't reach them at all, there's no wait option, and the default is the refund, never a swap they didn't choose.
